metadata.description: Lifecycle skills and Claude Code mods from the nng kit

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: Idea-to-shipped skill chain: brainstorm, make-plan, critique, execute-plan, commit, gh-create-pr, gh-draft-release, gh-tag-release

plugins.name: exec-observe
plugins.description: Live status for /exec runs of Cursor and Antigravity (agy) fleet plans, in a pane and status line, never in model context

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: Delegate fleet plan implementation to headless Cursor CLI or Google Antigravity CLI while Claude Code gates, reviews, and drives the verdict loop: /delegate:execute-via-cursor, /delegate:execute-via-agy

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Cross-surface handoff: save session intent in a git repo or a remote root, pick it up on any Claude surface
